public_rationale: The accessible reporting points toward losses but does not settle the stated comparison. The relevant 2023 figure is a projected operating loss; other reporting concerns a different year or an annualised revenue rate. None supplies matched realized operating costs and licensing/subscription revenue, or a complete profitability history. The claim also leaves its accounting basis unspecified, preventing a supported or contradicted financial verdict under the scoring rules.
limitations: The underlying financial reporting was partly inaccessible.
The available contextual item is a secondary summary, not a financial statement.
Unresolved does not mean that OpenAI was profitable.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has not turned a profit, and its operating costs vastly exceed its licensing and subscription revenue.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI may make billions, but it has yet to turn any kind of profit, and its operating costs vastly surpass any revenue it gets from licensing its technology or selling premium memberships.

from_speaker: has yet to turn any kind of profit
revenue it gets from licensing its technology or selling premium memberships
our_interpretation: Read profitability as company-level earnings after costs, rather than positive revenue or financing.
Read the cost comparison as operating costs substantially exceeding realized licensing and subscription revenue over the same period.
Use calendar 2023, the latest completed annual period before publication, for the ongoing operating-cost comparison; the post names no reporting period.
'Has yet' additionally claims an absence of prior profitability through publication; one annual loss cannot establish that entire history.
No accounting basis or attribution to company figures or press estimates is supplied in the quoted claim. Record the basis as unknown.
Do not impose an arbitrary numerical definition of 'vastly'.
criteria.support_condition: Matched financial records establish a substantial operating-cost excess over realized licensing and subscription revenue, together with a sufficiently complete history showing no company-level profit before publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish prior company-level profitability or show that operating costs did not substantially exceed the specified revenue in the target period.
